verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares is a SaaS equity-management platform, so official SDKs are a fair question, but the evidence pack never mentions an SDK, client library, or developer API. Probes for llms.txt, markdown docs, and OpenAPI specs all returned 404. The Gusto integration is a first-party product integration, not an SDK developers can build against, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
